content.text: No transition assistance or data return exists anywhere. I'll propose an insertion at the end of the termination section.

input.summary: Insert post-termination transition assistance, data return and certified deletion as new Section 6(c)
input.comment: [Playbook] We have added a standard exit provision: on expiry or termination, Contractor gives us up to six months of transition assistance at its then-current rates, returns our data and Confidential Information in a machine-readable format within 30 days, and then deletes and certifies deletion. Our playbook requires data return and orderly migration help on exit; we can accept a 90-day assistance window if six months is difficult to staff.

ops.text: (c) Upon expiry or termination of this Agreement or any Statement of Work for any reason, Contractor shall (i) at Company's request, provide reasonable transition assistance for up to six (6) months at Contractor's then-current rates; (ii) within thirty (30) days of such expiry or termination, return to Company all Works, Company data and Confidential Information in Contractor's possession or control, in a commonly used, machine-readable format; and (iii) thereafter delete all such data and Confidential Information from its systems and certify such deletion to Company in writing.
